result: Serial bounded adversarial review completed across equations, physical models, zero-allocation scopes, benchmark protocols, and release claims. Findings: (1) Physics models in spatial_models.rs satisfy exact semi-discrete conservation (sum dy/dt = 0 within 1e-13 for photon transport), exact operator linearity, spatial mesh-refinement convergence (ratio ~2.0 for upwind advection), and analytic Jacobian consistency (within 1e-5 vs finite differences). (2) Reference ladder fail-closed logic functioned correctly: semilinear 2d/3d models triggered REFERENCE_DISPUTED due to 1.07e-9 cross-family discrepancy exceeding the strict 1e-10 threshold, suppressing unverified performance claims. (3) Zero-allocation hot-loop contract (VG-1) is confirmed for numerical integration stepping (CollectiveRodas5pWorkspace::step_into, 0 heap allocations across 50 steps), while outer driver and solution returns are properly documented as bounded non-hot-loop allocations. (4) Live route dispatch in DriveState and discrete reference model in HybridRouteAutomaton are correctly documented. (5) Release verdict HOLD_NOT_RELEASE_QUALIFIED is fully upheld across all subsystems.
limitations: Review was executed serially within the orchestrated qualification workflow; external independent multi-party certification remains required for full production release.
